opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the industry (2027 plans: three dairy and three pig scholarships).
opportunities.summary: The Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship is aimed at young people aged 18-24 to develop young talent. It links successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network. The 2027 programme plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships, involving a 30-day study programme staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars. Fully funded including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. Applications open in November 2026 and close in early 2027.
